content.text: No liquidated damages, penalties, or early-termination fees payable by Client appear anywhere in the agreement. This satisfies the preferred position, so no redline is warranted.

input.quote: 14. TERMINATION. Subject to Section 4 hereof, TrueLink will continue to provide the requested Hosting Services and Support Services until the last day of the month following the month in which Client provides TrueLink with a written notice of its election to terminate this Agreement.
input.rationale: Searches for "liquidated damages", "penalty", "damages", "shall pay" and "late" return no Client-payable stipulated damages or penalty mechanic. The compensation clause (§5a) contains only ordinary monthly fees for services actually requested, with no default interest or late-payment penalty, and the disputes clause (§6) merely requires contested amounts to be paid pending resolution. The termination provision (§14) requires no early-termination fee or minimum payment on exit — Client simply gives notice and service runs to the end of the following month, and the non-renewal right in §13 is fee-free. The unsolicited e-mail covenant (§7) is a bare prohibition with no per-message or per-complaint charge attached. This meets the preferred position of no liquidated damages or penalties payable by Customer. Note only that §5a contemplates blank monthly minimums ("not less than $____ per month"); those are ongoing service minimums, not a termination liquidated amount, but the blanks should be completed commercially before signature.
